subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): keep blank credentials from overriding AWS auth

question: Should Bedrock repair whitespace-only AWS credential variables by permanently normalizing the gateway's shared process environment, or must the fix remain scoped to Bedrock client credential providers?
rationale: The current implementation fixes the reproduced AWS SDK failure across all known paths, but source inspection cannot decide whether the repository intentionally permits one provider to mutate AWS authentication state observed by unrelated in-process consumers.

options.title: Approve process-wide normalization
options.body: Accept deletion of whitespace-only AWS credential values before Bedrock resolution because those values cannot authenticate and currently poison the documented default chain.

options.title: Require Bedrock-scoped providers
options.body: Replace global environment mutation with explicit credential and token providers that skip blank environment sources only for Bedrock clients.

recommendation.title: Approve process-wide normalization
recommendation.body: Accept deletion of whitespace-only AWS credential values before Bedrock resolution because those values cannot authenticate and currently poison the documented default chain.

likelyOwner.reason: wirjo introduced both central Bedrock discovery and Mantle authentication surfaces affected by this decision.
